sentences: Your graphics card already plugs into a slot, so why does it need extra power cables?
The PCIe slot can supply up to 75 watts.
That's enough for a small, basic card.
But a mid-range or high-end card can pull 300 watts or more while gaming.
The rest comes straight from the power supply.
A 6-pin connector is rated for 75 watts.
75 from the slot plus two 8-pins gives 375 watts, enough for a 300 watt card.
So plug in every power connector on the card, firmly.
An empty socket can mean crashes or a black screen.
